event_attributes.comment: The file 'ssld' is a Linux ELF reverse shell and is a variant of WHIRLPOOL malware used on the Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) device (Figure 1). The file looks for an encoded string with a '.io' extension (Figure 2). The string will be decoded and the data will be passed as the C2 which will include the Internet Protocol (IP) address and port number used to establish a reverse shell.

Identity is used in STIX to represent, among other things, targets of attacks, information sources, object creators, and threat actor identities. (ref. STIX 2.1 - 4.5)
